text.en: This weapon fires a volley of rockets.

Deals 80% decreased damage to <link Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles [#CombatantClassifications] />.

Shoots a <bold wildly imprecise /> volley of 8 rockets. 

While within 5 meters of the ground, every 2 rockets fired grant x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge to you and nearby allies within a ? meter radius.
